narration._comment: Authored whole per locale. Arabic number-noun agreement is irregular (3-10 take a broken plural, 11+ a singular accusative), so a sentence built by substituting a count into a template produces wrong Arabic. The validator rejects a {count} placeholder in an ar string for exactly this reason.

hint1.en: Touch each one as you count it.

hint2.en: Let's count together, one at a time.

model.en: Watch me count them, then you try.

success.en: That is how many clues you have!

payload._comment: tenFrame sits second on the arrangement ladder (dice, tenFrame, linear, scatter, random). It is the right place to start a first Adventure: structured enough to support the one-to-one sweep, not so structured that it gives the answer away.
